title: Tool Over-Temperature
shortDescription: Tool stopped due to thermal protection.
fullDescription: Kobalt 24V Max XTR/40V Max tools blink one LED on the fuel gauge when motor or driver thermal limit is reached.

title: Over-Current Stall
fullDescription: Two blinks indicate the controller cut current due to bit jam or excessive load.

title: Low Battery Cutoff
fullDescription: Three LED blinks indicate the 24V/40V pack reached its protective discharge cutoff.

title: Battery Communication Error
fullDescription: Four blinks indicate handshake failure with the battery BMS, often dirty terminals.

title: Battery Over-Temperature
shortDescription: Battery pack too hot to discharge.
fullDescription: Five blinks indicate the pack NTC reads above limit.

title: Charger Pack Defect
fullDescription: Solid red on Kobalt charger indicates BMS lockout or cell failure.

title: Charger Temperature Hold
shortDescription: Pack too hot or cold to charge.
fullDescription: Charger blinks red waiting for pack to enter 0-45 C charging window.

title: Trigger Pulled During Insert
shortDescription: Tool inhibits run if trigger active at battery insert.
fullDescription: All LEDs flash if trigger is held while the pack is inserted - safety lockout.

fixSteps.title: Reinsert
fixSteps.instruction: Release trigger, remove and reinsert pack.

title: Tool Will Not Power On
shortDescription: No LEDs, no motor with charged pack.
fullDescription: Dead tool with confirmed-good pack typically means broken battery terminal block or controller failure.

fixSteps.title: Inspect terminals
fixSteps.instruction: Look for bent or burnt terminals in tool foot.

title: Erratic Speed Control
shortDescription: Tool surges or stutters at trigger.
fullDescription: Variable speed misbehaves due to dust on Hall-effect trigger or worn module.
